Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require compound_structures to ensure canonical SMILES are present. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
